features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light
features.text: You have superior vision in dim light and darkness. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Menacing

effects.note: When you take the Intimidation action, you can move up to 30 feet toward a creature within your line of sight. On a successful check, the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Intimidate from up to 30 feet further away
features.text: When you take the Intimidation action, you can move up to 30 feet toward a creature within your line of sight. On a successful check, the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Relentless Endurance

effects.note: When you have 0 hit points but are not killed outright, you can use your reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead. You regain the use of this after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: drop to 1 HP instead of dying outright
features.text: When you have 0 hit points but are not killed outright, you can use your reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead. You regain the use of this after a long rest.

features.name: Savage Attacks

effects.note: When you crit with a melee weapon attack, you roll one more weapon damage die a second time, adding it to the critical hit's damage. You can use this feature to make only one attack that uses the effect.

features.summary: An extra damage die when you land a critical melee hit
features.text: When you crit with a melee weapon attack, you roll one more weapon damage die a second time, adding it to the critical hit's damage. You can use this feature to make only one attack that uses the effect.

features.name: Stone's Endurance

effects.note: You can use your reaction to reduce the damage you take by 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier. You gain the use of this after a short or long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: reduce damage taken by 1d12 plus Con
features.text: You can use your reaction to reduce the damage you take by 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier. You gain the use of this after a short or long rest.

features.name: Powerful Build

effects.note: You have proficiency with the heavy armor, medium armor, and greataxes. Your capacity to carry heavy equipment is increased by 25 percent, and you have advantage on checks to determine or carry your load capacity, and you can use the normal or long jump as a stride much faster than usual. When you make a melee weapon attack using a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, your damage roll is increased by 1.

features.summary: Proficiency with heavy and medium armor and greataxes; +1 heavy damage

features.name: Mountain's Wisdom

effects.note: During downtime, you can spend 4 hours to gain temporary proficiency in a tool of your choice.

features.summary: Spend 4 hours of downtime to learn a tool
features.text: During downtime, you can spend 4 hours to gain temporary proficiency in a tool of your choice.

features.name: Fearless

effects.note: While you are frightened, you have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and your speed isn't reduced.

features.summary: Advantage on Wisdom saves and no speed loss while frightened
features.text: While you are frightened, you have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and your speed isn't reduced.

features.name: Falsely Shaped

effects.note: You can take the Disguise action. Your voice is a hollow flute sound, and your feathers are rusty brown. You have proficiency in the Deception skill, and you can read and write Common, Auran, and Celestial.

features.summary: Disguise as an action, plus Deception proficiency
features.text: You can take the Disguise action. Your voice is a hollow flute sound, and your feathers are rusty brown. You have proficiency in the Deception skill, and you can read and write Common, Auran, and Celestial.

features.name: Skillful

effects.note: You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand and Stealth skills, and your flying speed is equal to your walking speed. You can take the Dodge or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

features.summary: Sleight of Hand and Stealth proficiency, flight, bonus Dodge
features.text: You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand and Stealth skills, and your flying speed is equal to your walking speed. You can take the Dodge or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

features.name: Sneak

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to become invisible until someone makes a sound or an action that you can perceive against you, or until 1 hour has passed. If you attack, cast a spell, or take another action that requires you to be perceivable, the invisibility ends. You gain the use of this trait after a long rest.

features.summary: Once a day, turn invisible for an hour
features.text: You can use a bonus action to become invisible until someone makes a sound or an action that you can perceive against you, or until 1 hour has passed. If you attack, cast a spell, or take another action that requires you to be perceivable, the invisibility ends. You gain the use of this trait after a long rest.

features.name: Duplicate Form

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to assume a new form. When you do so, you replace your game statistics with those of another humanoid of your level, keeping your own Wisdom, Charisma, Intelligence, and the same alignment, and you keep your own size, speed, languages, and ability scores except Wisdom, Charisma, and Intelligence. You gain the statistics and game statistics, but not the class features or legendary actions, of another humanoid. You can't use a bonus action to revert to your normal form. You gain the use of this trait after a long rest.

features.summary: Once a day, take another humanoid's form for an hour
features.text: You can use a bonus action to assume a new form. When you do so, you replace your game statistics with those of another humanoid of your level, keeping your own Wisdom, Charisma, and Intelligence, and you keep your own size, speed, languages, and ability scores. You gain the use of this trait after a long rest.

features.name: Shapeshifter

effects.note: You can use an action to assume the appearance of another humanoid, without altering your game statistics. You must have seen a particular humanoid's appearance in the last 24 hours, or the GM can use a humanoid you've seen within the last week. You can't use this trait to disguise your game statistics. You regain the use of this trait after a long rest.
